market.what: ethylene control in produce storage/transport: 1-MCP + ethylene scavengers (KMnO4, Pd-zeolite, catalytic), world
market.method: 1-MCP ~$250M (AgroFresh $162M 2022 + generics, est.) + scavengers $154M (LP Info 2025); reports of $5.5-12.8B judged too high

value.logic: est.: ~100 Mt/yr climacteric produce stored or shipped cold x ~$800/t x 2 pts less loss = $1.6B; fruit/veg loss ~22% (FAO)
value.revenue_logic: 3 Mt produce/yr x ~$5/t trap media (1-MCP ~$25-35/t at $8-12 per 330 kg bin)
value.margin_logic: sorbent cartridges; cheap KMnO4 caps price

trend.drivers: food-loss goals (SDG 12.3), longer cold chains, organic fruit (1-MCP not allowed)

competition.notes: 1-MCP leader AgroFresh (private since 2023). Crowded field, cheap KMnO4 baseline.

lab.synth: Cu(I)/Ag(I) host or MOF-type sorbent, 3 variants (MOF/polymer tier); s0 not set yet
lab.test: ethylene isotherm + breakthrough 1-100 ppm at 0-5 C, 90% RH (GC-FID); fruit storage trial (banana/kiwi/tomato) 3-4 wk, firmness/color; e.g. UC Davis Postharvest
lab.logic: synth 10 wk ~$25k; tests 6 wk: gas sorption ~$8k + fruit trial ~$10k (est.)

sale.gates: cold-room scrubber: no food approval, 1 packhouse season pilot; in-pack sachet: EU 450/2009 active packaging + FDA FCN (~2 yr)
